ambiguities.aspect: Priority between load and shift when L=1 and E=1
readings: Load has priority: on the positive clock edge Q <= R
Shift has priority: on the positive clock edge Q <= w

ambiguities.aspect: Whether E gates load when L=1 and E=0
readings: L alone causes a load: Q <= R even when E=0
E is a global stage enable: when E=0, Q holds even if L=1

ambiguities.aspect: Initial value of Q with no reset input
readings: Q has no defined power-on value; before the first clock it is X/unknown
Q is assumed to start at 0, e.g. via implicit initial value or power-on reset
